findings.title: Claim asks for a DeviceClass that does not exist
findings.cause: request gpu of ResourceClaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-xrv9t-gpu-clt6p asks for devices of DeviceClass gpu.nvidia.com, which does not exist, so the scheduler cannot pick devices for it (the cluster's classes: accel.example.com, fpga.example.com, gpu.example.com, tpu.example.com); Deployment trainer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.command: kubectl get resourceclaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-xrv9t-gpu-clt6p -n kd-dra-device-class-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.devices.requests}'

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: request gpu: device class gpu.nvidia.com does not exist. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.

findings.fix: Name a DeviceClass the cluster has in request gpu of ResourceClaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-xrv9t-gpu-clt6p, or install the DRA driver that provides class gpu.nvidia.com (a driver's Helm chart usually creates its classes).
